spans.s: नैवि [naivi] बि [bi] ड्यम् [ḍyam], (बि) ड्यम् 1 Compactness, closeness, thickness, denseness.
नैवेद्यम् [naivēdyam], An offering of eatables presented to a deity or idol.
नैवेशिकम् [naivēśikam], 1 Any vessel or implement forming part of domestic furniture; नैवेशिकं सर्वगुणोपपन्नं ददाति वै यस्तु नरो द्विजाय
A present to a Brāhmaṇa householder, e. g. a girl or ornaments given with her.
